preselection: Official channels.csv shows these are in subsystem_6, physical_unit_3; channel_29/channel_30 same group 4, channel_31 group 7. Chosen from metadata before looking at this cohort's model metrics.
label_task: Detect official anomaly in channel_29, excluding windows overlapping invalid data or context-channel non-target anomalies. Rare nominal is negative, audited separately.
split: global official-ID-aware chronological 60/20/20 with no event ID among selected channels crossing boundary
training_reference: train partition fully nominal on all three channels only; sample 20000 uniformly spaced windows
model_selection: Validation point AP; choose one of 6 model/variant pairs exclusively using validation data
threshold: 99.8th percentile of official nominal validation scores, rare nominal excluded from cutoff fitting
limits: No fusion, no true 3-state physical fault labels
Known exposure to earlier Mission1 events via channel_21/channel_41 research; cannot claim truly untouched mission-wide event independence
Do not select threshold or model using test data
